description: This file contains implementation of functions related to Git worktree management, including creation, validation, linking, and repair of worktrees within a Git repository. It manages internal data structures, reference resolution, path handling, and filesystem operations pertinent to worktrees.

methods.name: void free_worktree(struct worktree * worktree)
methods.description: Frees memory associated with a worktree struct and its fields.

methods.name: void free_worktrees(struct worktree ** worktrees)
methods.description: Frees an array of worktree pointers and their internal structures.

methods.name: struct:worktree * get_main_worktree(int skip_reading_head)
methods.description: Retrieves the main worktree of the repository, optionally skipping head info reading.

methods.name: struct:worktree * get_linked_worktree(const char * id,int skip_reading_head)
methods.description: Retrieves a linked worktree by ID, optionally skipping head info reading.

methods.name: struct:worktree ** get_worktrees(void)
methods.description: Returns all worktrees including main and linked ones.

methods.name: struct:worktree ** get_worktrees_without_reading_head(void)
methods.description: Returns all worktrees without reading their head info.

methods.name: char * get_worktree_git_dir(const struct worktree * wt)
methods.description: Returns the git directory path associated with a worktree.

methods.name: struct:worktree * find_worktree(struct worktree ** list,const char * prefix,const char * arg)
methods.description: Finds a worktree by suffix or path, based on provided prefix and argument.

methods.name: struct:worktree * find_worktree_by_path(struct worktree ** list,const char * p)
methods.description: Finds a worktree by its filesystem path.

methods.name: int is_main_worktree(const struct worktree * wt)
methods.description: Checks if the given worktree is the main worktree.

methods.name: const char * worktree_lock_reason(struct worktree * wt)
methods.description: Returns the lock reason for a worktree if any.

methods.name: const char * worktree_prune_reason(struct worktree * wt,timestamp_t expire)
methods.description: Returns the prune reason if a worktree is eligible for pruning.

methods.name: int validate_worktree(const struct worktree * wt,struct strbuf * errmsg,unsigned flags)
methods.description: Validates the configuration and state of a worktree, reporting errors.

methods.name: void update_worktree_location(struct worktree * wt,const char * path_,int use_relative_paths)
methods.description: Relocates the worktree to a new filesystem path.

methods.name: int is_worktree_being_rebased(const struct worktree * wt,const char * target)
methods.description: Checks if a worktree is currently rebasing.

methods.name: int is_worktree_being_bisected(const struct worktree * wt,const char * target)
methods.description: Checks if a worktree is being bisected.

methods.name: int is_shared_symref(const struct worktree * wt,const char * symref,const char * target)
methods.description: Determines whether a given symref is shared across worktrees.

methods.name: const struct worktree * find_shared_symref(struct worktree ** worktrees,const char * symref,const char * target)
methods.description: Finds a worktree that shares a symref with another.

methods.name: int submodule_uses_worktrees(const char * path)
methods.description: Checks if a submodule uses worktrees by inspecting its config.

methods.name: void strbuf_worktree_ref(const struct worktree * wt,struct strbuf * sb,const char * refname)
methods.description: Appends the worktree reference prefix to a refname if applicable.

methods.name: int other_head_refs(each_ref_fn fn,void * cb_data)
methods.description: Iterates over other worktrees' HEAD references, executing a callback.

methods.name: void repair_gitfile(struct worktree * wt,worktree_repair_fn fn,void * cb_data,int use_relative_paths)
methods.description: Repairs a worktree's .git file if damaged or inconsistent.

methods.name: void repair_worktrees(worktree_repair_fn fn,void * cb_data,int use_relative_paths)
methods.description: Repairs all worktrees' .git files for consistency.

methods.name: void repair_worktree_after_gitdir_move(struct worktree * wt,const char * old_path)
methods.description: Repairs a worktree's gitdir after it has been moved.

methods.name: void repair_worktrees_after_gitdir_move(const char * old_path)
methods.description: Repairs all worktrees' gitdir references after a move.

methods.name: ssize_t infer_backlink(const char * gitfile,struct strbuf * inferred)
methods.description: Infers the correct backlink path for a worktree based on its gitfile.

methods.name: void repair_worktree_at_path(const char * path,worktree_repair_fn fn,void * cb_data,int use_relative_paths)
methods.description: Repairs the gitdir/link configuration of a worktree located at a specific path.

methods.name: int should_prune_worktree(const char * id,struct strbuf * reason,char ** wtpath,timestamp_t expire)
methods.description: Determines if a worktree should be pruned based on filesystem state and timestamps.

methods.name: int move_config_setting(const char * key,const char * value,const char * from_file,const char * to_file)
methods.description: Moves a config setting from one config file to another.

methods.name: int init_worktree_config(struct repository * r)
methods.description: Initializes worktree-related configuration in the repository.

methods.name: void write_worktree_linking_files(struct strbuf dotgit,struct strbuf gitdir,int use_relative_paths)
methods.description: Writes the symbolic linking files for a worktree's gitdir and .git reference.
